frozen_required_deliverable: A runner that clones the repository at an immutable SHA into a caller-supplied directory, executes the discovered PO-03 tests in a child process, and fails closed if the working tree is dirty or any required input is absent.

hidden_cases.rationale: The producer's tests never cover the central hypothesis condition: a committed test that only passes because of an UNCOMMITTED file in the source working tree. This is the actual warm-checkout dependence the runner is supposed to expose.
hidden_cases.construction: git repo with a committed test asserting Path('warm_only_helper.txt').exists(); the helper file was created in the source working tree only and never committed.

hidden_cases.rationale: The runner invokes subprocess.run with no timeout. A hanging committed test would hang the runner indefinitely.
hidden_cases.construction: committed test file containing 'import time; time.sleep(600)'; runner invoked with an external 20s cap.
hidden_cases.observed_output_verbatim: HC-D: runner HUNG >20s on a hanging committed test (no per-test timeout guard)
hidden_cases.interpretation: Confirmed robustness gap: command() calls subprocess.run without a timeout argument, so the runner cannot fail closed on a hung test. This is NOT one of the eight frozen acceptance criteria and does not by itself refute the frozen hypothesis, so it is recorded as a defect observation rather than a criterion failure.

reproducibility_check: Producer test suite and the real-repository run were each executed in fresh python3 -I processes; results were stable across runs. Runner sets PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 and passes -B to children, so no bytecode is emitted into the clone.
disposition_reason: Every frozen criterion is independently satisfied. The component is non-vacuous under two stub substitutions, has demonstrated real detection power against uncommitted-source-state dependence (HC-A), and reproduces the frozen hypothesis against the real repository at the immutable cohort commit rather than only against synthetic fixtures (HC-B, 12 test files, zero failures, clean tree). All manifest hashes, byte counts and the producer-cited external SHA verify exactly. The single defect found (no per-test subprocess timeout, HC-D) is outside the frozen criteria and is logged as a follow-up hardening item, not a basis for rejection.
followups_for_coordinator: clean_clone_runner.command() calls subprocess.run without timeout=; a hung committed PO-03 test hangs the runner with no fail-closed path (reviewer-observed, >20s hang).
